g.data-route: agreement at first reading: the Council approved the EP position

text.tspan: Legislative procedure – Directive on copyright and related rights in the Digital Single Market – Directive (EU) 2019/790

Procedure 2016/0280(COD). Route: agreement at first reading: the Council approved the EP position. Upper part: the ordinary legislative procedure (Art. 294 TFEU); lower part: the act's procedure over time. Every event cites its source (see copyright-dsm.html).
Act adopted in the wording of the EP
approves or no decision → adopted (7a); rejects
both adopt → adopted; otherwise not adopted
Informal: trilogues of EP, Council and Commission at every stage (Joint Declaration 2007, points 7–9); a trilogue agreement confirmed by Coreper and
offered by letter to the EP committee chair (point 14) leads to adoption at first reading, or, after the EP first reading, to an early second reading.
26 Mar 2019 · EP position at first reading
06 Oct 2016 · Referral to committee announced in plenary
05 Jul 2018 · Plenary reject committee interinstutional negotiations
12 Sep 2018 · Plenary refers back for trilogues
12 Sep 2018 · Plenary adopts amendments (mandate for trilogues)
